description: FAQ accordion using native HTML details/summary elements. Zero JavaScript required. Each item has a question and an HTML answer. Always emits a FAQPage JSON-LD structured-data block alongside the visible markup.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors). Also becomes the component's stable id.

title.description: Section heading displayed above the FAQ list.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title.

theme.description: Background color/tone. 'default' = surface background. 'dark' = dark surface with borders. 'inverted' = inverted background for strong contrast. Independent of content.

items.description: Array of FAQ items. Each item: { question: string, answer: string (HTML allowed) }.

--faq-item-bg.description: Individual accordion item background color or gradient

--faq-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading, if set

--faq-accent.description: Open-state question text color and chevron color
